items.title: 特斯拉Cybercab要來歐洲了！巴黎車展首度亮相但不開放搭乘
items.title_en: Tesla's Cybercab Heads to Europe! Debuts at Paris Motor Show but No Rides Offered
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)將在10月12日揭幕的巴黎車展，首度於歐洲展示自駕計程車Cybercab。這款沒有方向盤與踏板的車型，是執行長馬斯克推動特斯拉轉型為AI產品公司的重要布局，不過本次展出不開放觀眾搭乘。
《彭博》報導，巴黎車展總監Serge Gachot周二(6日)接受電話訪問時表示，觀眾可試駕另外六輛搭載特斯拉「全自動輔助駕駛」(Full Self-Driving，FSD)系統的車輛。FSD是特斯拉用於其駕駛輔助系統的名稱，與此次僅供展示的Cybercab不同。
Cybercab被視為特斯拉跨足電動車以外領域、朝包括人形機器人在內的AI產品發展的關鍵。馬斯克將這款車定位為未來大型自駕計程車業務的核心，目標是服務美國大部分地區，並承諾最終部署數千輛車。
本屆巴黎車展也將成為歐洲車廠展現新產品與轉型策略的舞台。擁有寶獅(Peugeot)及雪鐵龍(Citroën)品牌的Stellantis(STLA-US)，計畫展出旗下八個品牌、逾60輛車，呈現執行長Antonio Filosa帶領下的重振布局。
雷諾預計展出約50輛汽車與概念車，包括大幅改款的電動車Dacia Spring。該車將在歐洲組裝，以符合鼓勵在地生產的獎勵措施資格。
其他參展車廠包括中國比亞迪(01211-HK)、小鵬汽車(XPEV-US)(09868-HK)，以及德國福斯。
BMW則已於今年稍早宣布退出本屆巴黎車展。在公司發布重大獲利預警後，新任執行長Milan Nedeljkovic正推動削減成本。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) will unveil its driverless Cybercab at the Paris Motor Show on October 12, marking the first time the steering‑wheel‑less, pedal‑free vehicle is shown in Europe. The model is a key part of CEO Elon Musk’s push to transform Tesla into an AI product company, but it will not be available for public rides at the show.

Bloomberg reported that Paris Motor Show director Serge Gachot said in a phone interview on Tuesday (the 6th) that visitors can test‑drive six other vehicles equipped with Tesla’s Full Self‑Driving (FSD) system. FSD is the name of Tesla’s driver‑assistance suite and is different from the Cybercab, which is being displayed only.

The Cybercab is seen as a crucial step for Tesla to move beyond electric cars into AI products, including humanoid robots. Musk positions the vehicle as the core of a future large‑scale autonomous taxi service, aiming to serve most of the United States and eventually deploy thousands of units.

This year’s Paris Motor Show will also serve as a stage for European automakers to showcase new products and transformation strategies. Stellantis (STLA-US), owner of Peugeot and Citroën, plans to exhibit over 60 models across its eight brands, reflecting CEO Antonio Filosa’s revitalisation plan.

Renault expects to display about 50 cars and concept vehicles, including a heavily refreshed electric Dacia Spring. The model will be assembled in Europe to qualify for incentives that reward local production.
Other exhibitors include China’s BYD (01211-HK), Xpeng (XPEV-US) (09868-HK), and Germany’s Volkswagen.

BMW announced earlier this year that it would withdraw from this edition of the Paris Motor Show. After the company issued a major profit warning, new CEO Milan Nedeljkovic is driving cost‑cutting measures.

items.title: AI搶電大戰升溫！Google簽20年核電大單 電力股盤中大漲
items.title_en: AI Power Battle Heats Up! Google Signs 20-Year Nuclear Power Deal, Utility Stocks Surge Midday
paras: Google與美國最大核電反應爐持有業者Constellation Energy(CEG-US)達成20年核電購電協議，透過升級11座既有反應爐，新增890MW發電容量，規模約等同一座大型反應爐。這是核電業者與科技公司歷來最大的既有機組增容合作，帶動電力股周二(6日)盤中大漲。
《華爾街日報》(WJS)報導，Constellation將投入逾43億美元，升級伊利諾州、賓州與紐澤西州的核電機組。公司股價午盤上漲約14%，Talen Energy(TLN-US)、Vistra(VST-US)及NRG Energy(NRG-US)也分別上漲13%、11%與8%。

升級既有反應爐 加速供應資料中心用電

Constellation執行長Joe Dominguez表示，公司多年來就知道能提高這些反應爐的輸出，但工程成本高昂，如今Google提供財務支持，才得以推動相當於新增一座反應爐的計畫。首項增容工程預計2028年交付，其餘工程將持續至2032年或2033年。
雙方另簽訂15年供電協議，在涵蓋美國中大西洋與中西部地區的PJM電力市場，供應額外2,700MW電力，並計畫合作開發新電源、電池儲能及需求反應方案，在電網吃緊時調整或降低用電。
大型資料中心的耗電量可比擬一座城市，促使科技巨頭積極鎖定長期電源。核電能全天候提供低碳電力，卻有建造昂貴、耗時的難題。Google能源主管Amanda Peterson Corio表示，在資料中心備受批評之際，以負責任的方式迅速取得穩定、乾淨電力，格外重要。

科技巨頭搶核電 增容與重啟成優先選項

Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)近來積極增加電網供給。Google上月宣布支持喬治亞州核電廠升級，也與NextEra Energy(NEE-US)合作重啟愛荷華州Duane Arnold核電廠，並向反應爐開發商Kairos Power的計畫購電。
美國新建核電廠過去常面臨工期漫長與預算超支，既有機組升級及重啟近期關閉的反應爐，因此被視為較快增加供給的途徑，也符合川普政府擴大核電的方向。
Meta(META-US)今年與Vistra簽訂20年協議，包含俄亥俄州與賓州三座電廠合計433MW增容；亞馬遜(AMZN-US)上周也與Constellation簽署20年購電協議，涵蓋一座核電廠190MW增容計畫。
微軟(MSFT-US)則透過與Constellation合作，支持重啟賓州三哩島未受事故損壞的反應爐。該機組2019年因營運成本過高關閉，如今更名為Crane清潔能源中心，反映AI用電熱潮正改變核電投資條件。
paras_en: Google has reached a 20-year nuclear power purchase agreement with Constellation Energy (CEG-US), the largest U.S. nuclear reactor owner, to upgrade 11 existing reactors and add 890 MW of generation capacity—roughly the output of a large new reactor. This is the biggest capacity‑expansion partnership between a nuclear operator and a tech company ever, spurring utility stocks to jump sharply on Tuesday (the 6th).

The Wall Street Journal reports that Constellation will invest more than $4.3 billion to upgrade reactors in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey. The company’s shares rose about 14% by midday, while Talen Energy (TLN-US), Vistra (VST-US) and NRG Energy (NRG-US) gained 13%, 11% and 8% respectively.

Upgrading Existing Reactors to Accelerate Power Supply for Data Centers
Constellation CEO Joe Dominguez said the firm has long known it could boost output from these reactors, but the engineering costs are high. Google’s financial backing now makes it possible to pursue a project equivalent to building a new reactor. The first capacity‑increase project is slated for delivery in 2028, with the remaining upgrades continuing through 2032 or 2033.

The parties also signed a 15‑year power‑supply agreement covering the PJM market in the Mid‑Atlantic and Midwest, delivering an additional 2,700 MW of electricity and planning joint development of new generation, battery storage and demand‑response solutions to curtail or shift usage when the grid is tight.

Large data centers consume power comparable to a city, prompting tech giants to lock in long‑term energy sources. Nuclear power can provide round‑the‑clock low‑carbon electricity, but it is costly and time‑consuming to build. Google energy head Amanda Peterson Corio said that, amid criticism of data‑center energy use, securing stable, clean power responsibly is especially important.

Tech giants are scrambling for nuclear power, making capacity upgrades and reactor restarts top priorities. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) has recently been boosting grid supply: last month Google announced support for upgrades at a Georgia nuclear plant, partnered with NextEra Energy (NEE-US) to restart Iowa’s Duane Arnold reactor, and bought power from Kairos Power’s reactor development project.

New nuclear builds in the U.S. have historically suffered long schedules and budget overruns, so upgrading existing units and restarting recently shut reactors are seen as faster ways to add supply and align with the Trump administration’s push to expand nuclear power.

Meta (META-US) this year signed a 20‑year deal with Vistra that includes a 433 MW capacity increase across three plants in Ohio and Pennsylvania; Amazon (AMZN-US) last week also signed a 20‑year power‑purchase agreement with Constellation covering a 190 MW upgrade at a nuclear plant.

Microsoft (MSFT-US) is supporting the restart of a non‑damaged reactor at Pennsylvania’s Three Mile Island through its partnership with Constellation. The unit was shut in 2019 due to high operating costs, and has been renamed the Crane Clean Energy Center, reflecting how the AI‑driven power surge is reshaping nuclear investment conditions.

items.title: 油價下跌也別急著樂觀！EIA估第四季布蘭特均價105美元
items.title_en: Don't Get Too Optimistic About Falling Oil Prices! EIA Estimates Brent Average at $105 in Q4
paras: 美國能源資訊署(EIA)周二(6日)再度上調今明兩年油價預測，指出美伊戰爭導致全球庫存快速下降，柴油供應持續吃緊，將支撐原油價格維持高檔。EIA預估，第四季布蘭特原油均價約每桶105美元，較前次預測提高14美元。
EIA在《短期能源展望》中表示，2026年布蘭特均價預估上調至約98美元，較上月預測提高8%；2027年則估為84美元，上修10美元。柴油短缺促使煉油商提高柴油產量，也推升原油需求。美國零售柴油價格上月創新高後，10月預計仍高於每加侖6美元，2027年才逐步降至平均約4.50美元。
美國與以色列對伊朗的戰爭，擾亂荷姆茲海峽石油運輸，該航道戰前承載全球約20%的石油供應。油價周二雖下跌2%，但自2月28日開戰以來仍上漲逾37%。伊朗攻擊區域能源設施，也進一步壓抑原油生產。
EIA指出，沙國東西向輸油管遭襲，凸顯供應與價格面臨進一步干擾的風險。不過，該管線在青年運動攻擊後已恢復輸送，區域出口商也透過替代路線及船對船轉運，逐步恢復供應。
部分油輪採取關閉追蹤系統後在海上轉運貨物的方式，因應航運與能源設施遇襲。這些措施協助波斯灣不含伊朗的石油運輸量，於9月恢復至戰前逾81%。
EIA仍假設中東石油運輸將受限至今年第四季，但9月停產規模已是開戰以來最低。隨替代運輸方式擴大，預估停產量將由第四季每日450萬桶，降至2027年第一季的270萬桶。運輸改善與庫存回補，也有望帶動明年油價回落。
供給方面，EIA預估美國原油日產量今年達1,390萬桶，明年增至1,430萬桶，連兩年創新高。美國石油日需求則估今年降至2,060萬桶，明年回升至2,080萬桶。
paras_en: The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) on Tuesday (the 6th) again raised its oil price forecasts for this and next year, noting that the U.S.-Iran war has caused global inventories to drop rapidly, diesel supply remains tight, which will support crude oil prices at high levels. The EIA estimates the average Brent price in the fourth quarter at about $105 per barrel, $14 higher than its previous forecast.

In its Short-Term Energy Outlook, the EIA said the 2026 Brent average price is revised up to about $98, $8 higher than last month's forecast; for 2027 it is estimated at $84, $10 higher. Diesel shortages are prompting refiners to increase diesel output, also boosting crude demand. After U.S. retail diesel prices hit a new high last month, they are expected to stay above $6 per gallon in October, falling gradually to an average of about $4.50 in 2027.

The war between the United States and Israel against Iran has disrupted oil shipments through the Hormuz Strait, which before the conflict carried about 20% of global oil supply. Oil prices fell 2% on Tuesday, but have risen more than 37% since the war began on Feb. 28. Iran's attacks on regional energy facilities further suppress crude production.

The EIA noted that attacks on Saudi Arabia's east‑west oil pipeline highlight the risk of further supply and price disruptions. However, the pipeline resumed flow after the youth movement attack, and regional exporters are gradually restoring supply via alternative routes and ship‑to‑ship transfers.

Some tankers have turned off tracking systems and are transshipping cargo at sea in response to attacks on shipping and energy facilities. These measures have helped oil shipments from the Persian Gulf that do not include Iranian crude to recover to over 81% of pre‑war levels in September.

The EIA still assumes Middle‑East oil transport will remain constrained through Q4 of this year, but the scale of shutdowns in September was already the lowest since the war began. As alternative transport expands, the estimated shutdown volume is expected to fall from 4.5 million barrels per day in Q4 to 2.7 million barrels per day in Q1 2027. Improved transport and inventory replenishment could also push oil prices down next year.

On the supply side, the EIA projects U.S. crude oil production at 13.9 million barrels per day this year, rising to 14.3 million barrels per day next year, setting new highs for two consecutive years. U.S. daily oil demand is estimated to fall to 20.6 million barrels this year and rise to 20.8 million barrels next year.

items.title: 6億美元換五年授權！美光與Netlist專利戰達成和解
items.title_en: $600 Million for a Five‑Year License! Micron and Netlist Settle Patent Dispute
paras: 美光(MU-US)將支付6億美元，與記憶體技術公司Netlist(NLST-US)就記憶體晶片專利爭議達成和解，並取得涵蓋高頻寬記憶體(HBM)技術的專利組合授權，期限為五年。
《路透》報導，Netlist周二(6日)發布聲明表示，美光將每季支付3,000萬美元，五年合計6億美元。這項協議為雙方延續多年的專利爭端帶來進展，也涉及AI運算日益倚重的記憶體技術。
Netlist曾於2024年在美國德州馬歇爾聯邦法院贏得對美光的專利侵權訴訟，獲判4.45億美元賠償。今年9月，Netlist又向美國國際貿易委員會(ITC)提出新的侵權申訴，要求禁止進口用於Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、輝達(NVDA-US)及博通(AVGO-US)AI運算產品的美光晶片。
Netlist執行長C.K. Hong在聲明中表示：「與美光達成的協議，進一步證明我們AI記憶體技術的價值。」他強調，公司將持續保護智慧財產權，同時投入下一代產品開發。
美光發言人未立即回應《路透》對這項協議的置評要求。
這也是Netlist近期第二起與大型記憶體製造商達成的專利和解。今年8月，Netlist與三星電子(005930-KR)就另一項記憶體專利爭議達成和解；此前，Netlist已在德州對三星的專利訴訟中，獲判合計4.21億美元賠償。
paras_en: Micron (MU‑US) will pay $600 million to settle its memory‑chip patent dispute with memory‑technology company Netlist (NLST‑US) and obtain a five‑year license to Netlist’s patent portfolio covering high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) technology.

Reuters reported that Netlist issued a statement on Tuesday (the 6th) saying Micron will pay $30 million each quarter, totaling $600 million over five years. The agreement marks progress in a long‑running patent fight between the two firms and involves memory technologies that are increasingly critical for AI computing.

Netlist previously won a patent‑infringement lawsuit against Micron in 2024 at the U.S. District Court in Marshall, Texas, securing a $445 million judgment. In September this year, Netlist filed a new infringement complaint with the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) seeking to block imports of Micron chips used in AI products for Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US).

Netlist CEO C.K. Hong said in the statement, “The agreement with Micron further validates the value of our AI memory technology.” He emphasized that the company will continue to protect its intellectual property while investing in next‑generation product development.
A Micron spokesperson did not immediately respond to Reuters’ request for comment on the agreement.

This is Netlist’s second recent patent settlement with a major memory maker. In August, Netlist settled another memory‑patent dispute with Samsung Electronics (005930‑KR); previously, Netlist had won a Texas court case against Samsung that resulted in a $421 million judgment.

items.title: 貝思半導體目標價近乎腰斬！美銀示警艾司摩爾競爭威脅
items.title_en: Besi Semiconductor’s Target Price Slashed Nearly in Half! BofA Warns of Competitive Threat from ASML
paras: 美銀(BAC-US)警告，艾司摩爾(ASML-US)有意切入混合鍵合市場，可能威脅荷蘭設備商貝思半導體(Besi，全名為BE Semiconductor Industries N.V.)(BESIY-US)的成長前景，相關風險尚未反映在股價中。美銀將其評等由「買進」降至「中立」，目標價近乎腰斬，貝思荷蘭掛牌股票周二(6日)盤中一度下跌6.4%。
混合鍵合是將兩個晶片表面直接接合、省去中間金屬凸塊的技術，可提升散熱效率。貝思在此領域居領先地位，Bernstein分析師預估，2028年全球出貨的混合鍵合設備，每四台可能有三台來自貝思。
不過，美銀分析師Didier Scemama團隊指出，艾司摩爾已公開表達進軍意向，貝思也可能被迫加大研發投入。在艾司摩爾計畫更明朗前，這些風險恐持續壓抑股價。
投資人擔心記憶體製造商延後採用混合鍵合，是貝思第三季股價下跌約三分之一的原因之一，使其成為泛歐Stoxx 600指數當季表現最差的成分股。不過，今年以來仍上漲45%。
混合鍵合是貝思成長前景的核心。公司預期，樂觀情境下，到2030年可出貨逾2,000台設備；最新年報則顯示，截至2025年底，累計訂單逾150台。
艾司摩爾去年已交付首款先進封裝產品。執行長福克(Christophe Fouquet)4月表示，公司持續評估在混合鍵合領域支援客戶的機會。
美銀指出，良率偏低拖慢混合鍵合普及，堆疊多顆邏輯或記憶體晶片需要更高精準度，讓擅長高精度、高速微影技術的艾司摩爾有機會切入。即使未假設艾司摩爾將取得顯著市占，這項不確定性仍可能影響貝思估值。兩家公司均未立即回應置評要求。
paras_en: BofA (BAC-US) warned that ASML (ASML-US) intends to enter the hybrid bonding market, which could threaten the growth prospects of Dutch equipment maker Besi Semiconductor (full name BE Semiconductor Industries N.V.) (BESIY-US); the related risk is not yet reflected in the share price. BofA downgraded its rating from "Buy" to "Neutral" and cut the target price almost in half, and Besi’s Dutch‑listed shares fell as much as 6.4% mid‑day on Tuesday (the 6th).

Hybrid bonding is a technology that directly joins two chip surfaces, eliminating the intermediate metal bumps and improving thermal efficiency. Besi is a leader in this field; Bernstein analysts estimate that of the global hybrid bonding equipment shipped in 2028, three out of every four units could come from Besi.

However, BofA analyst Didier Scemama’s team noted that ASML has publicly expressed its intention to move into the market, and Besi may be forced to increase R&D spending. Until ASML’s plans become clearer, these risks could continue to suppress the stock price.

Investors worry that memory manufacturers delaying adoption of hybrid bonding is one of the reasons Besi’s share fell about one‑third in Q3, making it the worst‑performing component of the Euro Stoxx 600 this quarter. Nevertheless, it is still up 45% year‑to‑date.

Hybrid bonding is central to Besi’s growth outlook. The company expects, in an optimistic scenario, to ship more than 2,000 units by 2030; the latest annual report shows that as of the end of 2025, cumulative orders exceed 150 units.

ASML delivered its first advanced packaging product last year. CEO Christophe Fouquet said in April that the company continues to assess opportunities to support customers in the hybrid bonding space.

BofA pointed out that low yields slow the adoption of hybrid bonding; stacking multiple logic or memory dies requires higher precision, giving ASML, which excels in high‑precision, high‑speed lithography, a chance to enter. Even without assuming ASML will capture a significant market share, this uncertainty could still affect Besi’s valuation. Neither company responded immediately to comment requests.

items.title: AI需求撐腰！邁威爾上調2028年度營收展望 盤中股價飆逾7%
items.title_en: AI Demand Fuels Marvell’s 2028 Revenue Outlook Upgrade, Stock Surges Over 7% Intraday
paras: AI資料中心需求強勁，帶動客製化晶片業務成長，邁威爾(Marvell Technology)(MRVL-US)周二(6日)將2028會計年度營收預測上調至約200億美元，高於華爾街預期，並公布2031會計年度營收目標，展現對AI基礎建設商機的信心。消息激勵邁威爾盤中上漲逾7%，競爭對手博通(AVGO-US)也漲逾4%。
截稿前，邁威爾周二盤中股價上漲7.12%，每股暫報290.55美元。

paras_en: AI data‑center demand remains strong, driving growth in Marvell’s custom‑chip business. The news propelled Marvell up more than 7% during the session, while rival Broadcom (AVGO‑US) rose over 4%.
Before the close, Marvell’s share price was up 7.12% in midday trading, briefly reporting $290.55 per share.

According to data compiled by LSEG, analysts had originally projected Marvell’s fiscal 2028 revenue at $18.2 billion; the new outlook is about 10% higher. Marvell also estimates fiscal 2031 revenue could reach $70 billion to $90 billion, with a midpoint of $80 billion—far above the $46.85 billion median estimate from four analysts surveyed by Visible Alpha.

Marvell set its strategy as early as the 2021 investor day, focusing on custom chips optimized for cloud environments—products designed specifically for data centers. Since then, rapid expansion of AI infrastructure investment has made the company a primary beneficiary, and its stock has more than tripled year‑to‑date.

Custom chips have become a key growth engine for Marvell. Large tech firms are actively developing their own AI processors to reduce reliance on Nvidia (NVDA‑US) chips, further driving related design and supply demand.

items.title: 半導體股跌11%找買點？高盛點名財報前首選「這3檔」

Schneider 指出，費城半導體指數過去兩個月下跌 11%，同期標普 500 指數上漲 4%。高盛目前預期，多數半導體類股的獲利預估將上修。

高盛預期，應用材料將在 10 月 13 日的 SEMICON West 展會上調利潤率目標，並提出強勁的成長展望。該公司也將於 11 月中旬公布財報。

paras_en: Semiconductor stocks have retreated in recent months, but Goldman Sachs analyst James Schneider believes better trading opportunities will arise before earnings are released. Schneider notes that the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index has fallen 11% over the past two months, while the S&P 500 has risen 4% in the same period. Goldman Sachs currently expects earnings estimates for most semiconductor stocks to be revised upward.
Schneider is rated a five‑star analyst on the TipRanks platform, ranking 226th out of 12,512 tracked analysts. His investment rating success rate is 64% and the average return per rating is 29.40%.

Goldman Sachs’ confidence in these three stocks stems from several near‑term factors that could provide support. Applied Materials is set to attend an industry show, Seagate could benefit from stronger hard‑drive prices, and Microchip may gain from a recovery in the analog chip market.

Goldman Sachs expects Applied Materials to raise its profit margin target at the SEMICON West exhibition on October 13 and to present a strong growth outlook. The company will also report earnings in mid‑November.

Applied Materials primarily manufactures semiconductor production equipment. Goldman Sachs anticipates that, buoyed by demand for DRAM and advanced logic chips, the company’s quarterly results will be robust. Schneider also expects management to discuss the long‑term wafer‑fab equipment market potentially growing to $300 billion.
Applied Materials’ share price has risen about 12% over the past week and is up 110.14% year‑to‑date, indicating high market expectations.

items.title: TIS揭露上限引論戰！保險局捍衛三大監理原則 「承諾跳票」標示最快明年4月底現形
items.title_en: TIS Disclosure Upper Limit Sparks Debate! Insurance Bureau Defends Three Core Supervisory Principles, “Commitment Default” Star Mark to Appear by End of April 2027
paras: 富邦金控(2881-TW)董事長昨(5)日公開透露富邦人壽真實 TIS(資本適足率)177%，市場關注是否打破金管會的揭露規定。保險局副局長蔡火炎今(6)日與媒體唇槍舌戰，強調監理上限是為維持市場穩定與公平性，不希望私下揭露、排名造成混淆，業者若自認體質健全亦可申請提早終止過渡。此外，保險局也證實，檢驗業者資本改善承諾的兩顆星「**」標示，最快將於明(2027)年4月現形，藉此評估業者有無說到做到。
我國保險業接軌新一代清償能力制度，金管會提供業者15年的選擇性過渡措施，依現行規範，有申請過渡的壽險公司，即便上半年因獲利良好、自行算出過渡後的 TIS 比率高於當初向保險局申報的目標值，公開資訊揭露時仍必須以「目標資本適足率」為上限，如140%，並在右上角加註「*」號標示。
媒體質疑，富邦人壽若因本身投資與獲利能力優異而算出TIS 177%，保險局卻強制要求蓋上「140%上限」的帽子，導致市場與外資分析師無法辨識誰才是真正財務體質健全的公司，「資訊揭露初衷不就是讓好的被看到、差的去改善嗎？」媒體直批，資本適足率與淨值比長年以來是保戶、投資人評估保險公司財務風險最重要的指標，如今蓋上保護傘後，外界完全失去比較基準。
對此，蔡火炎提出三大核心監理立場，首先，過渡措施的分子與分母均有納入監理給予的資本調整數(借來的額度)，因此，過渡後的計算數值並不能反映完全的經濟實質。為避免15年過渡期間公司的TIS比率隨市場劇烈波動、影響金融穩定，金管會訂定「揭露以目標值為上限」是既定監理架構，並非臨時變更。
對於富邦人壽揭露的TIS 177% 與提前結束過渡期，蔡火炎明確表態，金管會允許業者申請提早終止選擇性過渡措施。一旦終止，公司未來數值「是多少就寫多少」，不再受上限限制。他也警示，「一旦申請提早終止，未來若財務狀況不如預期，絕不可能再回頭申請適用過渡措施。」
其次，蔡火炎強調，資本適足率是保險局對公司的資本監理工具，本就不適合拿來做公司間的排名比較，更不能當作業務員在市場上招攬保單、打壓同業的競爭工具。他建議保戶與投資人應綜合參考財報、EPS、淨值比及保單繼續率等 20 多項財業務公開資訊。
第三則是針對承諾跳票的公司，「**」懲罰性的標示何時出現？蔡火炎表示，保險局將在今年底檢驗各大壽險公司「說到有沒有做到」，若業者今年度未達成資本改善規劃目標，最快在2027年4月底公布今年底TIS比率時，就會首度出現「兩顆星」的懲罰性標示。
paras_en: Fubon Financial Holding (2881‑TW) chairman publicly disclosed yesterday (May 5) that Fubon Life’s actual TIS (capital adequacy ratio) stands at 177%, prompting market speculation about a possible breach of the Financial Supervisory Commission’s disclosure rules. Insurance Bureau Deputy Director Cai Huoyan engaged in a sharp exchange with the media today (May 6), stressing that the supervisory ceiling is intended to preserve market stability and fairness and that private disclosures or rankings could cause confusion. Companies that consider themselves financially sound may also apply to terminate the transitional period early. The bureau also confirmed that the two‑star “**” penalty label for firms that fail to meet capital‑improvement commitments could appear as early as April 2027, allowing regulators to assess whether firms follow through on their promises.

Taiwan’s insurance sector is aligning with a new generation solvency framework, with the Financial Supervisory Commission offering a 15‑year optional transition. Under current rules, life insurers that have applied for the transition must, even if strong first‑half earnings yield a post‑transition TIS higher than the target originally reported to the bureau, disclose only the “target capital adequacy ratio” as the ceiling—e.g., 140%—and mark it with an asterisk in the upper‑right corner.

The media questioned why, if Fubon Life’s own calculations show a TIS of 177% thanks to superior investment and profit performance, the bureau would force a “140% ceiling” label, preventing the market and foreign analysts from identifying the truly financially sound companies. They argued that the purpose of disclosure is to highlight the strong and push the weak to improve, and that capital adequacy and net‑worth ratios have long been the key metrics for policyholders and investors to assess insurers’ financial risk. With a protective cap now in place, the external benchmark disappears.

In response, Cai Huoyan outlined three core supervisory positions. First, both the numerator and denominator in the transition calculations incorporate capital adjustments granted by regulators (borrowed capacity), so the post‑transition figures do not fully reflect economic reality. To prevent a company’s TIS from wildly fluctuating during the 15‑year transition and threatening financial stability, the FSC set the “disclosure limited to the target value” rule as a fixed supervisory framework, not a temporary change.

Regarding Fubon Life’s disclosed 177% TIS and its request to end the transition early, Cai stated that the FSC permits firms to apply for early termination of the optional transition. Once terminated, the company may report whatever figure it actually has, without any ceiling. He warned that if a firm applies for early termination and later its financial condition falls short of expectations, it cannot revert to the transition regime.

Second, Cai emphasized that the capital adequacy ratio is a supervisory tool of the Insurance Bureau, not a metric for inter‑company ranking or a marketing weapon for agents to attract policies or pressure competitors. He advised policyholders and investors to consider a comprehensive set of more than 20 disclosed financial and operational indicators, such as financial statements, EPS, net‑worth ratios, and policy persistency rates.

Third, concerning firms that miss their improvement commitments, Cai explained that the punitive “**” star label will appear when. The bureau will assess at year‑end whether each major life insurer has fulfilled its capital‑improvement plan. If a company fails to meet its target this year, the two‑star penalty could be applied as early as the end of April 2027 when the year‑end TIS is published.

The bureau will assess at year‑end whether each major life insurer has fulfilled its capital‑improvement plan. If a company fails to meet its target this year, the two‑star penalty could be applied as early as the end of April 2027 when the year‑end TIS is published.

items.title: 金管會釋利多！擴大保險業「健康福祉事業」投資範疇 保單脫鉤、非上市櫃公司可100%控股
items.title_en: Financial Supervisory Commission Announces Positive Move: Expands Insurance Industry’s Investment Scope in Health and Welfare Business, Allows Full Ownership of Non‑Listed Companies and Decouples Policies
paras: 為加速壽險資金轉型並因應超高齡社會需求，金管會保險局今(6)日發布最新令釋，全面放寬保險業投資「健康福祉事業」之限制。本次修法最大亮點在於徹底解開投資標的與「保單業務(核保、理賠、給付)」連結的硬性限制，未來服務對象不再侷限於保戶；同時針對非上市櫃健康事業，保險業最高可持股達 100%，盼引導壽險資金注入產業，構建全齡金融與健康生態圈。
保險局副局長蔡火炎表示，本次法令修正主要基於三大核心考量，首先，隨人口高齡化，民眾對健康管理與長照之需求急遽增加；第二，舊制要求投資事業必須與保單給付或核保理賠強行連結，致使業者投資彈性大受限制；新制實施後，服務客群可擴及一般大眾。第三，希望引導保險業從傳統「事後損害填補」，延伸至事前的「健康促進、疾病預防」及事後的「長照與生活支持」。
政策即日起生效，金管會並將健康福祉事業劃分為五大核心領域，包括健康管理及健康促進(含健檢、藥局通路)、健康醫療科技及數位應用、長期照顧及全齡友善服務(含機構管顧、輔具服務)、健康飲食及營養支持及健康福祉整合平台。
針對壽險業者的投資布局，蔡火炎透露，經初步瞭解，目前業者投資意願最高的領域集中於健康管理顧問、藥局通路及長照輔助服務。
在資金投資上限與股權規範上，金管會釐清三大情境：
保險局提醒，住宿式長照機構與日照中心因屬衛福部特定許可機構，不在本次開放投資範疇內。
不過，外界擔憂龐大保險資金是否會壟斷國內藥局與健檢市場，保險局強調，審核的核心關注點在於「跨專業的營運風險控制」。
蔡火炎指出，健康福祉產業非保險業者本業，保險公司提出申請案時，金管會將嚴審其是否具備專業技術與相符的經營團隊，以確保保險資金運用的安全性、流動性與收益性，兼顧社會觀感與保戶權益。
paras_en: To accelerate the transformation of life‑insurance capital and meet the needs of an ultra‑aged society, the Financial Supervisory Commission’s Insurance Bureau issued a new order today (the 6th), fully relaxing restrictions on insurance‑industry investments in “health and welfare businesses.” The key highlight of the amendment is the complete removal of the hard link between investment targets and “policy business (underwriting, claims, payouts),” meaning future service targets will no longer be limited to policyholders; at the same time, for non‑listed health enterprises, insurers may now hold up to 100% of the equity, aiming to channel life‑insurance funds into the sector and build an all‑age financial and health ecosystem.

Insurance Bureau Deputy Director Cai Huoyan said the regulatory revision is based on three core considerations: first, as the population ages, demand for health management and long‑term care is soaring; second, the old rules forced investment projects to be tightly tied to policy payouts or underwriting claims, severely limiting investment flexibility; under the new regime, the customer base can expand to the general public. Third, the goal is to shift insurers from traditional “post‑loss compensation” toward proactive “health promotion, disease prevention” and, subsequently, “long‑term care and life support.”

The policy takes effect immediately, and the FSC categorizes health and welfare businesses into five core domains: health management and promotion (including health checks and pharmacy channels), health‑care technology and digital applications, long‑term care and all‑age friendly services (including institutional consulting and assistive‑device services), health nutrition and dietary support, and integrated health‑welfare platforms.

Regarding the investment layout of life‑insurance firms, Cai Huoyan disclosed that, based on preliminary surveys, the areas with the highest investment interest are health‑management consulting, pharmacy channels, and long‑term‑care assistance services.
The FSC clarified three scenarios concerning investment caps and equity rules.

The Insurance Bureau reminded that residential long‑term‑care facilities and day‑care centers, being institutions licensed by the Ministry of Health and Welfare, are not included in the newly opened investment scope.

However, concerns have been raised that massive insurance capital could dominate domestic pharmacy and health‑check markets; the bureau emphasized that the core focus of review is “cross‑professional operational risk control.”

Cai Huoyan noted that the health‑welfare industry is not the core business of insurers. When an insurance company submits an application, the FSC will rigorously assess whether it possesses the requisite professional expertise and an appropriate management team, to ensure the safety, liquidity and profitability of insurance‑fund usage while balancing public perception and policyholder interests.

items.title: 〈台北紡織展〉從世界盃球衣到AI智慧製造 台灣機能性紡織品全球市占約7成
items.title_en: Taipei Textile Expo Showcases From World Cup Jerseys to AI Smart Manufacturing, Taiwan’s Functional Textiles Hold About 70% Global Market Share
paras: 2026台北紡織展（TITAS）今（6）日迎來30周年，經濟部產業發展署主題館首度於南港展覽館1館登場，以「數位整合、高值創新、永續未來」為3大主軸，集結17家紡織、鞋業及袋包業者，展示智慧製造、高值產品及循環經濟等轉型成果，彰顯台灣紡織業以數位與永續轉型、搶攻國際市場的實力。
本次主題館由紡織所、工研院、紡拓會及鞋技中心4大法人共同執行，開幕活動並邀請製衣公會、絲織公會、不織布公會、手提包公會、產業用紡織品協會及台灣精品品牌協會等代表共襄盛舉。
產發署署長邱求慧表示，台灣紡織業擁有完整上中下游供應鏈，國際競爭力高居全球前段班。以114年數據來看，台灣紡織產業產值達3125億元、出口值約62億美元，其中機能性紡織品全球市占率更高達約7成。例如7月落幕的2026世界盃足球賽，遠東新(1402-TW)以回收再生紗打造球衣，獲22支國家隊採用，展現台灣紡織實力。
邱求慧指出，國際市場需求正快速轉變，品牌客戶下單趨向「少量多樣」，交期大幅縮短，對精準碳排數據的要求也日益嚴格，加上資深技術師傅面臨傳承斷層等挑戰。因此，台灣紡織業未來必須靠AI提升生產效率、靠低碳循環取得國際市場入場門票，再透過高值創新拉開與競爭對手的差距。
為加速產業轉型升級，產發署近5年投入近30億元，輔導與補助超過1600家次廠商，帶動產業投資近55億元。經濟部並於114年成立「產業競爭力輔導團」，整合經濟部各單位及勞動部資源，光是今年在紡織領域已完成AI診斷輔導超過350案，培育AI專業人才逾560人次，協助業者加速數位轉型。
展區也呈現業者「用AI把經驗變效率」的轉型成果。深耕鞋材多年的坤璜企業，將上萬筆料號與資深師傅經驗導入AI系統，如今只要拍照並口述需求，3分鐘即可產出報價表，報價效率提升40倍；至誼實業則導入3D虛擬製樣，轉型為品牌研發夥伴，並與HP(HPQ-US)合作開發VR背包、量產1萬個，每年更出口1.2萬個自行車輪袋至奧地利。
paras_en: The 2026 Taipei Textile Expo (TITAS) celebrated its 30th anniversary today (the 6th), with the Ministry of Economic Affairs’ Industrial Development Agency debuting its themed pavilion at Nangang Exhibition Hall 1. Centered on “Digital Integration, High‑Value Innovation, Sustainable Future,” the pavilion gathered 17 textile, footwear and bag manufacturers to display smart manufacturing, high‑value products and circular‑economy transformation results, highlighting Taiwan’s textile industry’s strength in digital and sustainable transformation and its push into international markets.

The themed pavilion was jointly executed by four major institutions—the Institute of Textiles, Industrial Technology Research Institute, Textile Development Association and Shoe Technology Center—and the opening ceremony invited representatives from the Garment Association, Silk Weaving Association, Non‑Woven Fabric Association, Handbag Association, Industrial Textile Products Association and Taiwan Boutique Brand Association to participate.

Industrial Development Agency Director Qiu Qiu‑hui said Taiwan’s textile sector boasts a complete upstream‑midstream‑downstream supply chain and ranks among the world’s top in competitiveness. According to 2025 data, the industry’s output value reached NT$312.5 billion with exports of about US$6.2 billion, and functional textiles command roughly 70% of the global market share. For example, at the 2026 World Cup that concluded in July, Far Eastern New (1402‑TW) produced jerseys from recycled yarn, which were adopted by 22 national teams, showcasing Taiwan’s textile prowess.

Qiu noted that international demand is shifting rapidly, with brand customers favoring “small‑batch, diverse” orders, dramatically shortened lead times, and increasingly strict requirements for precise carbon‑emission data. Coupled with a looming gap in senior technical talent, Taiwan’s textile industry must rely on AI to boost production efficiency, adopt low‑carbon circular practices to gain market entry, and leverage high‑value innovation to differentiate from competitors.

To accelerate industry transformation, the agency has invested nearly NT$3 billion over the past five years, assisting and subsidizing more than 1,600 firms and spurring about NT$5.5 billion in industry investment. In 2025 the Ministry of Economic Affairs also established an “Industry Competitiveness Advisory Team,” integrating resources from various ministries and the Labor Ministry. This year alone, over 350 AI diagnostic projects have been completed in the textile sector, more than 560 AI‑specialized personnel have been trained, and companies have been helped to speed up digital transformation.

The exhibition also displayed how companies are “turning experience into efficiency with AI.” Kun‑Huang Enterprise, a long‑time shoe‑material specialist, fed tens of thousands of part numbers and veteran craftsmen’s knowledge into an AI system; now a photo and spoken request can generate a quotation in three minutes, a 40‑fold increase in speed. Zhi‑Yi Industrial has adopted 3D virtual prototyping, becoming a brand‑R&D partner and collaborating with HP (HPQ‑US) to develop VR backpacks, producing 10,000 units and exporting 12,000 bicycle‑wheel bags annually to Austria.

items.title: 逾3.7萬「純舊制」勞退申辦自提 每3人就有1人搶「卡位」退休紅利
items.title_en: More Than 37,000 Pure Old‑Plan Workers Apply for Voluntary Contributions, About One in Three Grab the Retirement Bonus Slot
paras: 勞工退休金條例施行細則於2026年7月15日修正發布後，開放純舊制勞工自願提繳退休金，並允許符合退休條件者經勞雇協商提前結算舊制退休金存入個人專戶。勞動部6日公布最新數據指出，開放以來申辦情況極為踴躍，截至8月31日止已有超過3.7萬位純舊制勞工申請自願提繳，佔推估總人數逾32%，帶動整體自願提繳率提升2個百分點以上；同時截至9月30日止，已有200家事業單位與666位勞工合意結存近21億元退休金，展現強勁政策效益。
勞動部表示，此次法規修正旨在協助適用純舊制之勞工完善退休規劃。統計顯示，2025年12月推估之純舊制勞工人數約為11.5萬人，新制上路短短一個多月，即吸引3.7萬餘名純舊制勞工響應自提，相當於每3位純舊制勞工就有1人選擇自提，顯見廣大勞工對自我退休保障之重視。
在合意結存舊制退休金方面，截至2026年9月30日止，已有200家事業單位與666位勞工完成勞雇協商，將退休金結算並存入個人專戶，總結存金額高達20.99億元，平均每位勞工結算金額約為315萬餘元。其中結算規模最大之單一事業單位，一次與38位純舊制勞工達成協議，結算金額高達8,700萬餘元，顯見勞雇雙方對於提前結算制度之肯定與信任。
除了純舊制勞工外，勞動部特別提醒事業單位，切勿忽視選擇新制但保留舊制年資（俗稱「舊轉新」）的資深員工。依據勞工退休金條例規定，「舊轉新」勞工本即可經勞雇合意結清舊制年資並轉入個人專戶。2026年截至8月31日止，已有7,666名「舊轉新」勞工完成結清，總金額約達56.49億元，平均每人結算金額約73萬餘元。勞動部呼籲雇主在與純舊制勞工協商時應一視同仁，促進勞雇關係和諧與員工權益。
此外，依據勞工退休準備金提撥及管理辦法第9條規定，事業單位於給付相關退休金且無後續法定支付義務後，得向當地主管機關申請領回準備金賸餘款。2026年截至8月31日止，已有2,223家事業單位辦理專戶註銷，成功領回約41.62億元賸餘款。其中單一事業單位最高領回高達2.6455億元，此舉能為企業注入一筆可彈性運用之活水資金，創造勞雇雙贏局面。
勞動部補充說明，為協助勞雇雙方了解新制流程，已設置「勞退純舊制勞工自願提繳及提前結存退休金」專區，提供協議書範本、常見問答及法令解釋等豐富資源。勞雇雙方若有相關疑問，可透過免付費專線1955進行諮詢，及早做好退休規劃準備。
paras_en: After the detailed rules of the Labor Pension Act were revised and released on July 15, 2026, workers under the pure old‑plan were allowed to voluntarily contribute to their pension and, if they meet retirement conditions, to settle their old‑plan pension early through employer‑employee negotiation and deposit it into a personal account. The Ministry of Labor announced on the 6th that the response has been extremely enthusiastic: by August 31, more than 37,000 pure old‑plan workers had applied for voluntary contributions, accounting for over 32% of the estimated total, pushing the overall voluntary contribution rate up by more than two percentage points. By September 30, 200 enterprises and 666 workers had mutually agreed to settle nearly NT$2.1 billion of pension funds, demonstrating strong policy impact.

The Ministry said the regulatory amendment aims to help pure old‑plan workers improve their retirement planning. Statistics show that the estimated number of pure old‑plan workers in December 2025 was about 115,000. In just over a month since the new system launched, more than 37,000 pure old‑plan workers have responded to the voluntary contribution option – roughly one out of every three pure old‑plan workers – indicating a high level of concern for self‑secured retirement.

Regarding mutually agreed settlements of old‑plan pensions, by September 30, 2026, 200 enterprises and 666 workers had completed employer‑employee negotiations, settling and depositing the pension into personal accounts for a total of NT$20.99 billion, an average of about NT$3.15 million per worker. The largest single enterprise settled with 38 pure old‑plan workers at once, amounting to more than NT$87 million, showing strong confidence and trust in the early settlement system from both sides.

In addition to pure old‑plan workers, the Ministry specifically reminded enterprises not to overlook senior staff who have switched to the new plan but retained old‑plan service years (commonly called “old‑to‑new”). Under the Labor Pension Act, “old‑to‑new” workers can also settle their old‑plan service years by mutual agreement and transfer the amount to a personal account. By August 31, 2026, 7,666 “old‑to‑new” workers had completed settlements, totaling about NT$5.649 billion, an average of roughly NT$730,000 per person. The Ministry urged employers to treat pure old‑plan workers and “old‑to‑new” workers equally in negotiations to promote harmonious labor relations and protect employee rights.

Furthermore, according to Article 9 of the Regulations on the Allocation and Management of Labor Retirement Preparation Funds, enterprises that have paid the relevant pension and have no further statutory payment obligations may apply to the local authority to reclaim surplus preparation funds. By August 31, 2026, 2,223 enterprises had closed their special accounts and successfully reclaimed about NT$4.162 billion in surplus. The highest single‑enterprise reclamation reached NT$2.6455 billion, providing companies with flexible liquid capital and creating a win‑win situation for both labor and management.

The Ministry added that to help both parties understand the new system’s procedures, it has set up a dedicated “Voluntary Contributions and Early Settlement for Pure Old‑Plan Workers” portal, offering template agreements, FAQs, and legal interpretations. Employers and employees with questions can consult the toll‑free hotline 1955 for free advice and prepare their retirement plans early.

items.title: 信義區周慶開打 新光三越：消費者更愛買體驗和生活升級
items.title_en: Xinyi District Anniversary Sale Kicks Off Shin Kong Mitsukoshi: Consumers Prefer Buying Experiences and Lifestyle Upgrades
paras: 新光三越台北信義新天地周年慶將於10月15日盛大開打，一口氣集結超過千家品牌、200家以上新品牌和50家以上全台獨家新櫃共同拚買氣，首14日祭出限定滿仟送點優惠；新光三越強調，今年主要的消費趨勢是消費型態正從「買商品」，走向「買體驗、買興趣、買生活升級」，因此，看好「新場域、新話題、新商品」將是成長的三大動能。
新光三越指出，信義店前三季來客成長約5%，並未明顯受北市新商場開出的影響，主要反映展覽快閃、科技新品與收藏經濟 、高階家電、潮流輕奢和大規模改裝SKM MEN’S等新業態帶動。
在此趨勢下，新光三越信義店今年周慶主打「 新場域、新話題、新商品 」三大動能，提出SKM MEN’S一週年 、 日本展 、 寶可夢 30週年 、 animate、 FANATICS 以及美妝 、 3C、 家電 、運動等明星商品，持續放大人潮與買氣。
新光三越表示，消費者追的不只是折扣，更是話題速度，因此，今年首度規劃「TOP 100 MUST BUY」百大必買商品，從「全球爆款首發」、「社群洗版特搜」到「明星同款必搶」，將散落在全球、社群、明星與不同生活領域的流行訊號，整理成一張年度消費趨勢地圖；從「現在最熱賣」一路看到「下一個會紅」，一次掌握2026年度消費趨勢全貌。
paras_en: Shin Kong Mitsukoshi’s Taipei Xinyi New World anniversary celebration will launch in grand style on October 15, gathering more than a thousand brands, over 200 new brands and more than 50 exclusive Taiwan‑only new counters to boost sales. For the first 14 days, a limited‑time promotion offers bonus points for purchases over NT$1,000. The retailer emphasizes that this year’s main consumer trend is shifting from “buying goods” to “buying experiences, interests and lifestyle upgrades,” and sees “new venues, new topics, new products” as the three key growth drivers.

Shin Kong Mitsukoshi notes that visitor traffic at its Xinyi store grew about 5% in the first three quarters, showing no obvious impact from the opening of new malls in the city. The increase is mainly attributed to pop‑up exhibitions, tech新品, the collector economy, high‑end home appliances, trendy affordable luxury, and large‑scale remodels such as SKM MEN’S, which represent new business formats.

Riding this trend, the Xinyi store’s anniversary this year focuses on the three engines of “new venues, new topics, new products,” featuring the one‑year anniversary of SKM MEN’S, a Japan exhibition, the 30th anniversary of Pokémon, animate, FANATICS, as well as star items in beauty, 3C, home appliances and sports, continuously drawing crowds and sales.

Shin Kong Mitsukoshi says consumers are after more than discounts—they chase hot topics. Accordingly, this year it is debuting a “TOP 100 MUST‑BUY” list, compiling the year’s must‑have items from “global breakout launches,” “social‑media buzz picks,” to “celebrity‑approved must‑haves.” The list maps trending signals from around the world, social platforms, celebrities and various lifestyle sectors into a single annual consumer‑trend map, letting shoppers see today’s best‑sellers and anticipate tomorrow’s hits, capturing the full picture of 2026’s consumption trends.

items.title: 特斯拉Cybercab要來歐洲了！巴黎車展首度亮相但不開放搭乘
items.title_en: Tesla's Cybercab Heads to Europe! Debuts at Paris Motor Show but No Rides Offered
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)將在10月12日揭幕的巴黎車展，首度於歐洲展示自駕計程車Cybercab。這款沒有方向盤與踏板的車型，是執行長馬斯克推動特斯拉轉型為AI產品公司的重要布局，不過本次展出不開放觀眾搭乘。
《彭博》報導，巴黎車展總監Serge Gachot周二(6日)接受電話訪問時表示，觀眾可試駕另外六輛搭載特斯拉「全自動輔助駕駛」(Full Self-Driving，FSD)系統的車輛。FSD是特斯拉用於其駕駛輔助系統的名稱，與此次僅供展示的Cybercab不同。
Cybercab被視為特斯拉跨足電動車以外領域、朝包括人形機器人在內的AI產品發展的關鍵。馬斯克將這款車定位為未來大型自駕計程車業務的核心，目標是服務美國大部分地區，並承諾最終部署數千輛車。
本屆巴黎車展也將成為歐洲車廠展現新產品與轉型策略的舞台。擁有寶獅(Peugeot)及雪鐵龍(Citroën)品牌的Stellantis(STLA-US)，計畫展出旗下八個品牌、逾60輛車，呈現執行長Antonio Filosa帶領下的重振布局。
雷諾預計展出約50輛汽車與概念車，包括大幅改款的電動車Dacia Spring。該車將在歐洲組裝，以符合鼓勵在地生產的獎勵措施資格。
其他參展車廠包括中國比亞迪(01211-HK)、小鵬汽車(XPEV-US)(09868-HK)，以及德國福斯。
BMW則已於今年稍早宣布退出本屆巴黎車展。在公司發布重大獲利預警後，新任執行長Milan Nedeljkovic正推動削減成本。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) will unveil its driverless Cybercab at the Paris Motor Show on October 12, marking the first time the steering‑wheel‑less, pedal‑free vehicle is shown in Europe. The model is a key part of CEO Elon Musk’s push to transform Tesla into an AI product company, but it will not be available for public rides at the show.

Bloomberg reported that Paris Motor Show director Serge Gachot said in a phone interview on Tuesday (the 6th) that visitors can test‑drive six other vehicles equipped with Tesla’s Full Self‑Driving (FSD) system. FSD is the name of Tesla’s driver‑assistance suite and is different from the Cybercab, which is being displayed only.

The Cybercab is seen as a crucial step for Tesla to move beyond electric cars into AI products, including humanoid robots. Musk positions the vehicle as the core of a future large‑scale autonomous taxi service, aiming to serve most of the United States and eventually deploy thousands of units.

This year’s Paris Motor Show will also serve as a stage for European automakers to showcase new products and transformation strategies. Stellantis (STLA-US), owner of Peugeot and Citroën, plans to exhibit over 60 models across its eight brands, reflecting CEO Antonio Filosa’s revitalisation plan.

Renault expects to display about 50 cars and concept vehicles, including a heavily refreshed electric Dacia Spring. The model will be assembled in Europe to qualify for incentives that reward local production.
Other exhibitors include China’s BYD (01211-HK), Xpeng (XPEV-US) (09868-HK), and Germany’s Volkswagen.

BMW announced earlier this year that it would withdraw from this edition of the Paris Motor Show. After the company issued a major profit warning, new CEO Milan Nedeljkovic is driving cost‑cutting measures.

items.title: AI搶電大戰升溫！Google簽20年核電大單 電力股盤中大漲
items.title_en: AI Power Battle Heats Up! Google Signs 20-Year Nuclear Power Deal, Utility Stocks Surge Midday
paras: Google與美國最大核電反應爐持有業者Constellation Energy(CEG-US)達成20年核電購電協議，透過升級11座既有反應爐，新增890MW發電容量，規模約等同一座大型反應爐。這是核電業者與科技公司歷來最大的既有機組增容合作，帶動電力股周二(6日)盤中大漲。
《華爾街日報》(WJS)報導，Constellation將投入逾43億美元，升級伊利諾州、賓州與紐澤西州的核電機組。公司股價午盤上漲約14%，Talen Energy(TLN-US)、Vistra(VST-US)及NRG Energy(NRG-US)也分別上漲13%、11%與8%。

升級既有反應爐 加速供應資料中心用電

Constellation執行長Joe Dominguez表示，公司多年來就知道能提高這些反應爐的輸出，但工程成本高昂，如今Google提供財務支持，才得以推動相當於新增一座反應爐的計畫。首項增容工程預計2028年交付，其餘工程將持續至2032年或2033年。
雙方另簽訂15年供電協議，在涵蓋美國中大西洋與中西部地區的PJM電力市場，供應額外2,700MW電力，並計畫合作開發新電源、電池儲能及需求反應方案，在電網吃緊時調整或降低用電。
大型資料中心的耗電量可比擬一座城市，促使科技巨頭積極鎖定長期電源。核電能全天候提供低碳電力，卻有建造昂貴、耗時的難題。Google能源主管Amanda Peterson Corio表示，在資料中心備受批評之際，以負責任的方式迅速取得穩定、乾淨電力，格外重要。

科技巨頭搶核電 增容與重啟成優先選項

Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)近來積極增加電網供給。Google上月宣布支持喬治亞州核電廠升級，也與NextEra Energy(NEE-US)合作重啟愛荷華州Duane Arnold核電廠，並向反應爐開發商Kairos Power的計畫購電。
美國新建核電廠過去常面臨工期漫長與預算超支，既有機組升級及重啟近期關閉的反應爐，因此被視為較快增加供給的途徑，也符合川普政府擴大核電的方向。
Meta(META-US)今年與Vistra簽訂20年協議，包含俄亥俄州與賓州三座電廠合計433MW增容；亞馬遜(AMZN-US)上周也與Constellation簽署20年購電協議，涵蓋一座核電廠190MW增容計畫。
微軟(MSFT-US)則透過與Constellation合作，支持重啟賓州三哩島未受事故損壞的反應爐。該機組2019年因營運成本過高關閉，如今更名為Crane清潔能源中心，反映AI用電熱潮正改變核電投資條件。
paras_en: Google has reached a 20-year nuclear power purchase agreement with Constellation Energy (CEG-US), the largest U.S. nuclear reactor owner, to upgrade 11 existing reactors and add 890 MW of generation capacity—roughly the output of a large new reactor. This is the biggest capacity‑expansion partnership between a nuclear operator and a tech company ever, spurring utility stocks to jump sharply on Tuesday (the 6th).

The Wall Street Journal reports that Constellation will invest more than $4.3 billion to upgrade reactors in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey. The company’s shares rose about 14% by midday, while Talen Energy (TLN-US), Vistra (VST-US) and NRG Energy (NRG-US) gained 13%, 11% and 8% respectively.

Upgrading Existing Reactors to Accelerate Power Supply for Data Centers
Constellation CEO Joe Dominguez said the firm has long known it could boost output from these reactors, but the engineering costs are high. Google’s financial backing now makes it possible to pursue a project equivalent to building a new reactor. The first capacity‑increase project is slated for delivery in 2028, with the remaining upgrades continuing through 2032 or 2033.

The parties also signed a 15‑year power‑supply agreement covering the PJM market in the Mid‑Atlantic and Midwest, delivering an additional 2,700 MW of electricity and planning joint development of new generation, battery storage and demand‑response solutions to curtail or shift usage when the grid is tight.

Large data centers consume power comparable to a city, prompting tech giants to lock in long‑term energy sources. Nuclear power can provide round‑the‑clock low‑carbon electricity, but it is costly and time‑consuming to build. Google energy head Amanda Peterson Corio said that, amid criticism of data‑center energy use, securing stable, clean power responsibly is especially important.

Tech giants are scrambling for nuclear power, making capacity upgrades and reactor restarts top priorities. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) has recently been boosting grid supply: last month Google announced support for upgrades at a Georgia nuclear plant, partnered with NextEra Energy (NEE-US) to restart Iowa’s Duane Arnold reactor, and bought power from Kairos Power’s reactor development project.

New nuclear builds in the U.S. have historically suffered long schedules and budget overruns, so upgrading existing units and restarting recently shut reactors are seen as faster ways to add supply and align with the Trump administration’s push to expand nuclear power.

Meta (META-US) this year signed a 20‑year deal with Vistra that includes a 433 MW capacity increase across three plants in Ohio and Pennsylvania; Amazon (AMZN-US) last week also signed a 20‑year power‑purchase agreement with Constellation covering a 190 MW upgrade at a nuclear plant.

Microsoft (MSFT-US) is supporting the restart of a non‑damaged reactor at Pennsylvania’s Three Mile Island through its partnership with Constellation. The unit was shut in 2019 due to high operating costs, and has been renamed the Crane Clean Energy Center, reflecting how the AI‑driven power surge is reshaping nuclear investment conditions.

items.title: 油價下跌也別急著樂觀！EIA估第四季布蘭特均價105美元
items.title_en: Don't Get Too Optimistic About Falling Oil Prices! EIA Estimates Brent Average at $105 in Q4
paras: 美國能源資訊署(EIA)周二(6日)再度上調今明兩年油價預測，指出美伊戰爭導致全球庫存快速下降，柴油供應持續吃緊，將支撐原油價格維持高檔。EIA預估，第四季布蘭特原油均價約每桶105美元，較前次預測提高14美元。
EIA在《短期能源展望》中表示，2026年布蘭特均價預估上調至約98美元，較上月預測提高8%；2027年則估為84美元，上修10美元。柴油短缺促使煉油商提高柴油產量，也推升原油需求。美國零售柴油價格上月創新高後，10月預計仍高於每加侖6美元，2027年才逐步降至平均約4.50美元。
美國與以色列對伊朗的戰爭，擾亂荷姆茲海峽石油運輸，該航道戰前承載全球約20%的石油供應。油價周二雖下跌2%，但自2月28日開戰以來仍上漲逾37%。伊朗攻擊區域能源設施，也進一步壓抑原油生產。
EIA指出，沙國東西向輸油管遭襲，凸顯供應與價格面臨進一步干擾的風險。不過，該管線在青年運動攻擊後已恢復輸送，區域出口商也透過替代路線及船對船轉運，逐步恢復供應。
部分油輪採取關閉追蹤系統後在海上轉運貨物的方式，因應航運與能源設施遇襲。這些措施協助波斯灣不含伊朗的石油運輸量，於9月恢復至戰前逾81%。
EIA仍假設中東石油運輸將受限至今年第四季，但9月停產規模已是開戰以來最低。隨替代運輸方式擴大，預估停產量將由第四季每日450萬桶，降至2027年第一季的270萬桶。運輸改善與庫存回補，也有望帶動明年油價回落。
供給方面，EIA預估美國原油日產量今年達1,390萬桶，明年增至1,430萬桶，連兩年創新高。美國石油日需求則估今年降至2,060萬桶，明年回升至2,080萬桶。
paras_en: The U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) on Tuesday (the 6th) again raised its oil price forecasts for this and next year, noting that the U.S.-Iran war has caused global inventories to drop rapidly, diesel supply remains tight, which will support crude oil prices at high levels. The EIA estimates the average Brent price in the fourth quarter at about $105 per barrel, $14 higher than its previous forecast.

In its Short-Term Energy Outlook, the EIA said the 2026 Brent average price is revised up to about $98, $8 higher than last month's forecast; for 2027 it is estimated at $84, $10 higher. Diesel shortages are prompting refiners to increase diesel output, also boosting crude demand. After U.S. retail diesel prices hit a new high last month, they are expected to stay above $6 per gallon in October, falling gradually to an average of about $4.50 in 2027.

The war between the United States and Israel against Iran has disrupted oil shipments through the Hormuz Strait, which before the conflict carried about 20% of global oil supply. Oil prices fell 2% on Tuesday, but have risen more than 37% since the war began on Feb. 28. Iran's attacks on regional energy facilities further suppress crude production.

The EIA noted that attacks on Saudi Arabia's east‑west oil pipeline highlight the risk of further supply and price disruptions. However, the pipeline resumed flow after the youth movement attack, and regional exporters are gradually restoring supply via alternative routes and ship‑to‑ship transfers.

Some tankers have turned off tracking systems and are transshipping cargo at sea in response to attacks on shipping and energy facilities. These measures have helped oil shipments from the Persian Gulf that do not include Iranian crude to recover to over 81% of pre‑war levels in September.

The EIA still assumes Middle‑East oil transport will remain constrained through Q4 of this year, but the scale of shutdowns in September was already the lowest since the war began. As alternative transport expands, the estimated shutdown volume is expected to fall from 4.5 million barrels per day in Q4 to 2.7 million barrels per day in Q1 2027. Improved transport and inventory replenishment could also push oil prices down next year.

On the supply side, the EIA projects U.S. crude oil production at 13.9 million barrels per day this year, rising to 14.3 million barrels per day next year, setting new highs for two consecutive years. U.S. daily oil demand is estimated to fall to 20.6 million barrels this year and rise to 20.8 million barrels next year.

items.title: 6億美元換五年授權！美光與Netlist專利戰達成和解
items.title_en: $600 Million for a Five‑Year License! Micron and Netlist Settle Patent Dispute
paras: 美光(MU-US)將支付6億美元，與記憶體技術公司Netlist(NLST-US)就記憶體晶片專利爭議達成和解，並取得涵蓋高頻寬記憶體(HBM)技術的專利組合授權，期限為五年。
《路透》報導，Netlist周二(6日)發布聲明表示，美光將每季支付3,000萬美元，五年合計6億美元。這項協議為雙方延續多年的專利爭端帶來進展，也涉及AI運算日益倚重的記憶體技術。
Netlist曾於2024年在美國德州馬歇爾聯邦法院贏得對美光的專利侵權訴訟，獲判4.45億美元賠償。今年9月，Netlist又向美國國際貿易委員會(ITC)提出新的侵權申訴，要求禁止進口用於Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)、輝達(NVDA-US)及博通(AVGO-US)AI運算產品的美光晶片。
Netlist執行長C.K. Hong在聲明中表示：「與美光達成的協議，進一步證明我們AI記憶體技術的價值。」他強調，公司將持續保護智慧財產權，同時投入下一代產品開發。
美光發言人未立即回應《路透》對這項協議的置評要求。
這也是Netlist近期第二起與大型記憶體製造商達成的專利和解。今年8月，Netlist與三星電子(005930-KR)就另一項記憶體專利爭議達成和解；此前，Netlist已在德州對三星的專利訴訟中，獲判合計4.21億美元賠償。
paras_en: Micron (MU‑US) will pay $600 million to settle its memory‑chip patent dispute with memory‑technology company Netlist (NLST‑US) and obtain a five‑year license to Netlist’s patent portfolio covering high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) technology.

Reuters reported that Netlist issued a statement on Tuesday (the 6th) saying Micron will pay $30 million each quarter, totaling $600 million over five years. The agreement marks progress in a long‑running patent fight between the two firms and involves memory technologies that are increasingly critical for AI computing.

Netlist previously won a patent‑infringement lawsuit against Micron in 2024 at the U.S. District Court in Marshall, Texas, securing a $445 million judgment. In September this year, Netlist filed a new infringement complaint with the U.S. International Trade Commission (ITC) seeking to block imports of Micron chips used in AI products for Alphabet (GOOGL‑US), Nvidia (NVDA‑US) and Broadcom (AVGO‑US).

Netlist CEO C.K. Hong said in the statement, “The agreement with Micron further validates the value of our AI memory technology.” He emphasized that the company will continue to protect its intellectual property while investing in next‑generation product development.
A Micron spokesperson did not immediately respond to Reuters’ request for comment on the agreement.

This is Netlist’s second recent patent settlement with a major memory maker. In August, Netlist settled another memory‑patent dispute with Samsung Electronics (005930‑KR); previously, Netlist had won a Texas court case against Samsung that resulted in a $421 million judgment.

items.title: AI需求撐腰！邁威爾上調2028年度營收展望 盤中股價飆逾7%
items.title_en: AI Demand Fuels Marvell’s 2028 Revenue Outlook Upgrade, Stock Surges Over 7% Intraday
paras: AI資料中心需求強勁，帶動客製化晶片業務成長，邁威爾(Marvell Technology)(MRVL-US)周二(6日)將2028會計年度營收預測上調至約200億美元，高於華爾街預期，並公布2031會計年度營收目標，展現對AI基礎建設商機的信心。消息激勵邁威爾盤中上漲逾7%，競爭對手博通(AVGO-US)也漲逾4%。
截稿前，邁威爾周二盤中股價上漲7.12%，每股暫報290.55美元。
根據LSEG彙整數據，分析師原先預估邁威爾2028會計年度營收為182億美元，公司最新預測高出約10%。邁威爾並預估，2031會計年度營收可達700億至900億美元，區間中值800億美元，遠高於Visible Alpha調查四名分析師所得的468.5億美元預估。
邁威爾早在2021年投資人日便確立策略，聚焦客製化及針對雲端環境最佳化的晶片，也就是專為資料中心設計的產品。此後，隨著AI基礎建設投資快速擴張，公司成為主要受惠者之一，今年以來股價已漲至原來的三倍以上。
客製化晶片如今已是邁威爾的重要成長引擎。大型科技公司積極開發自家AI處理器，希望降低對輝達(NVDA-US)晶片的依賴，進一步帶動相關設計與供應需求。
邁威爾8月揭露與Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google的合作協議，若達成效能里程碑，至2033會計年度為止，最高可帶來1,200億美元銷售額。同月，公司也將全年營收展望由165億美元上調至約180億美元。此次再提高2028會計年度預測，凸顯客製化資料中心晶片需求持續升溫。
paras_en: AI data‑center demand remains strong, driving growth in Marvell’s custom‑chip business. On Tuesday (the 6th), Marvell Technology (MRVL‑US) lifted its fiscal 2028 revenue forecast to roughly $20 billion, above Wall Street expectations, and also disclosed a fiscal 2031 revenue target, signaling confidence in AI infrastructure opportunities. The news propelled Marvell up more than 7% during the session, while rival Broadcom (AVGO‑US) rose over 4%.
Before the close, Marvell’s share price was up 7.12% in midday trading, briefly reporting $290.55 per share.

According to data compiled by LSEG, analysts had originally projected Marvell’s fiscal 2028 revenue at $18.2 billion; the new outlook is about 10% higher. Marvell also estimates fiscal 2031 revenue could reach $70 billion to $90 billion, with a midpoint of $80 billion—far above the $46.85 billion median estimate from four analysts surveyed by Visible Alpha.

Marvell set its strategy as early as the 2021 investor day, focusing on custom chips optimized for cloud environments—products designed specifically for data centers. Since then, rapid expansion of AI infrastructure investment has made the company a primary beneficiary, and its stock has more than tripled year‑to‑date.

Custom chips have become a key growth engine for Marvell. Large tech firms are actively developing their own AI processors to reduce reliance on Nvidia (NVDA‑US) chips, further driving related design and supply demand.

In August, Marvell disclosed a partnership agreement with Google, a subsidiary of Alphabet (GOOGL‑US). If performance milestones are met, the deal could generate up to $120 billion in sales through fiscal 2033. In the same month, the company raised its full‑year revenue outlook from $16.5 billion to about $18 billion. This latest upgrade to the fiscal 2028 forecast underscores the continued heating of demand for custom data‑center chips.

items.title: Google擴大核電採購簽20年長約支持Constellation既有機組增容890MW
items.title_en: Google expands nuclear power procurement, signs 20-year long-term contract to support Constellation’s existing units adding 890 MW
paras: 2026年10月07日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心用電需求快速增加，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)旗下Google擴大布局核電，與美國大型核電營運商Constellation Energy(CEG-US)簽署兩項長期電力協議，合計涉及3,590 MW電力與容量，其中890 MW來自既有核電機組升級後新增的發電容量，另外2,700 MW則由Constellation現有PJM核電資產供應。
Google首先與Constellation簽署20年電力採購協議(PPA)，支持後者透過核電機組升級（uprate）新增890 MW發電容量，並將新增電力供應至PJM Interconnection電網。Constellation預計投入超過43億美元，針對位於伊利諾州、賓州與紐澤西州的既有核電資產進行設備與數位化升級，首批新增容量預計自2028年開始交付。
AI資料中心需要全天候、大規模供電，讓核電重新受到科技業青睞。相較新建大型核反應爐從許可到完工可能需要10年以上，現有核電機組的延役、擴充與重啟，可以更快增加穩定電力供應，也成為近期科技公司布局的重點。
Amazon(AMZN-US)近期同樣與Constellation簽署電力協議，採購690MW電力，其中包括馬里蘭州Calvert Cliffs核電廠現代化工程增加的發電容量。
Google也已著手鎖定其他核電資源。公司2025年與NextEra Energy(NEE-US)簽署電力採購協議，支持重啟愛荷華州Duane Arnold核反應爐，該機組自2020年起停止運轉。
Microsoft(MSFT-US)則在2024年簽署長期購電協議，支持Constellation重啟賓州三哩島（Three Mile Island）核電廠的反應爐，Constellation規劃於2027年恢復運轉。科技業對核電的需求，也因此從新一代小型模組化反應爐(SMR)，延伸至既有核電機組擴充及停機機組重啟。

Constellation Energy(CEG-US)本身至目前為止，已與Google、Amazon(AMZN-US)、Meta Platforms(META-US)及Walmart(WMT-US)等大型企業簽署長期核電供應協議，四份主要合約涉及的電力規模合計約5.6GW，其中增容與擴容部分約1.1GW。從合約結構來看，大型科技與企業客戶正透過長期購電承諾，直接支撐既有核電機組升級與擴建投資，也讓AI資料中心需求逐步轉化為實際新增電力容量。

paras_en: October 7, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – As AI data centers’ electricity demand surges, Alphabet’s (GOOGL-US) Google is expanding its nuclear power footprint, signing two long‑term power agreements with U.S. nuclear operator Constellation Energy (CEG-US). The deals cover a total of 3,590 MW of power and capacity, including 890 MW of new generation from upgrades to existing nuclear units and an additional 2,700 MW supplied from Constellation’s current PJM nuclear assets.

Google first signed a 20‑year power purchase agreement (PPA) with Constellation, supporting the latter’s uprate of existing reactors to add 890 MW of generation, which will be fed into the PJM Interconnection grid. Constellation plans to invest more than $4.3 billion to upgrade equipment and digitize its existing nuclear assets in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey, with the first new capacity expected to be delivered starting in 2028.

AI data centers require round‑the‑clock, large‑scale power, bringing nuclear back into favor with the tech sector. Compared with building new large reactors, which can take over a decade from licensing to completion, extending, expanding or restarting existing plants can boost stable power supply much faster and has become a focus of recent tech‑company strategies.

Amazon (AMZN‑US) recently also signed a power agreement with Constellation, purchasing 690 MW of electricity, including capacity added by the modernization of the Calvert Cliffs nuclear plant in Maryland.

Google has also begun targeting other nuclear resources. In 2025 the company signed a power purchase agreement with NextEra Energy (NEE‑US) to support the restart of the Duane Arnold reactor in Iowa, which has been offline since 2020.

Microsoft (MSFT‑US) signed a long‑term power purchase agreement in 2024 to support Constellation’s restart of the Three Mile Island reactor in Pennsylvania, with Constellation planning to bring it back online in 2027. The tech industry’s demand for nuclear power therefore extends from next‑generation small modular reactors (SMRs) to upgrades of existing units and the restart of shut‑down plants.

Constellation Energy (CEG‑US) to date has signed long‑term nuclear supply agreements with major corporations such as Google, Amazon (AMZN‑US), Meta Platforms (META‑US) and Walmart (WMT‑US). The four main contracts involve roughly 5.6 GW of power, with about 1.1 GW coming from capacity expansions and uprates. The contract structures show that large tech and corporate customers are using long‑term purchase commitments to directly fund upgrades and expansions of existing nuclear units, turning AI data‑center demand into actual new generation capacity.

items.title: 半導體股跌11%找買點？高盛點名財報前首選「這3檔」
items.title_en: Semiconductor Stocks Down 11% Looking for Buying Opportunities? Goldman Sachs Highlights These 3 Picks Before Earnings
paras: 半導體股近幾個月回檔，但高盛分析師 James Schneider 認為，財報公布前將出現更好的交易機會。高盛將應用材料(AMAT-US) 、希捷科技(STX-US) 及微芯科技(MCHP-US) 列為「戰術性布局首選」。
Schneider 指出，費城半導體指數過去兩個月下跌 11%，同期標普 500 指數上漲 4%。高盛目前預期，多數半導體類股的獲利預估將上修。
Schneider 在 TipRanks 平台獲評為五星分析師，在該平台追蹤的 12,512 名分析師中排名第 226。他的投資評等勝率為 64%，每次評等的平均報酬率為 29.40%。
高盛看好這三檔股票的原因，在於近期有幾項因素可望提供支撐。應用材料即將參加產業展會，希捷可望受惠於硬碟價格走強，微芯科技則可能獲得類比晶片市場復甦的助力。
高盛預期，應用材料將在 10 月 13 日的 SEMICON West 展會上調利潤率目標，並提出強勁的成長展望。該公司也將於 11 月中旬公布財報。
應用材料主要生產半導體製造設備。高盛預期，受惠於 DRAM 與先進邏輯晶片需求，該公司單季業績將表現強勁。Schneider 也預期，管理層將談及晶圓製造設備市場長期規模可能朝 3,000 億美元成長的前景。
應用材料股價過去一週上漲約 12%，今年來累計漲幅達 110.14%，顯示市場期待已相當高。
希捷方面，高盛預期，硬碟價格上漲與穩健需求將帶動單季業績表現，營收可望較華爾街預估高出約 2%，財測則可能較市場共識高出約 3%。
高盛也指出，希捷採取「審慎的供應策略」，並持續推進熱輔助磁記錄（HAMR）技術，透過雷射提高硬碟儲存容量。分析師認為，在硬碟需求維持強勁之際，這些因素可望協助希捷擴大市占率。希捷股價今年來累計上漲 208.29%。
微芯科技方面，高盛預期，該公司將受惠於資料中心、航太與國防領域的強勁需求，營收可望較市場預估高出約 1%，毛利率則有望在 2026 年底前回升至約 66%。
高盛分析師也認為，華爾街低估了微芯科技類比晶片業務的復甦力道，並將該公司列為「最看好的個股之一」。高盛對其 2027 會計年度的獲利預估較市場共識高出約 3%。微芯科技股價今年來累計上漲 27.62%。
根據 TipRanks 股票比較工具，以分析師目標價估算，微芯科技的潛在上漲空間最高，達 30.49%；希捷次之，為 27.96%；應用材料則為 25.00%。
華爾街對應用材料與希捷的共識評等均為「強力買進」，對微晶片科技的共識評等則為「適度買進」。
paras_en: Semiconductor stocks have retreated in recent months, but Goldman Sachs analyst James Schneider believes better trading opportunities will arise before earnings are released. Goldman Sachs lists Applied Materials (AMAT-US), Seagate Technology (STX-US) and Microchip Technology (MCHP-US) as the "tactical layout top choices."

Schneider notes that the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index has fallen 11% over the past two months, while the S&P 500 has risen 4% in the same period. Goldman Sachs currently expects earnings estimates for most semiconductor stocks to be revised upward.
Schneider is rated a five‑star analyst on the TipRanks platform, ranking 226th out of 12,512 tracked analysts. His investment rating success rate is 64% and the average return per rating is 29.40%.

Goldman Sachs’ confidence in these three stocks stems from several near‑term factors that could provide support. Applied Materials is set to attend an industry show, Seagate could benefit from stronger hard‑drive prices, and Microchip may gain from a recovery in the analog chip market.

Goldman Sachs expects Applied Materials to raise its profit margin target at the SEMICON West exhibition on October 13 and to present a strong growth outlook. The company will also report earnings in mid‑November.

Applied Materials primarily manufactures semiconductor production equipment. Goldman Sachs anticipates that, buoyed by demand for DRAM and advanced logic chips, the company’s quarterly results will be robust. Schneider also expects management to discuss the long‑term wafer‑fab equipment market potentially growing to $300 billion.
Applied Materials’ share price has risen about 12% over the past week and is up 110.14% year‑to‑date, indicating high market expectations.

Regarding Seagate, Goldman Sachs expects rising hard‑drive prices and solid demand to drive quarterly performance, with revenue likely about 2% above Wall Street estimates and earnings roughly 3% higher than consensus.

Goldman Sachs also points out that Seagate is pursuing a "cautious supply strategy" and continues advancing heat‑assisted magnetic recording (HAMR) technology, using lasers to increase drive capacity. Analysts believe these factors, amid strong drive demand, could help Seagate expand market share. Seagate’s stock is up 208.29% year‑to‑date.

For Microchip Technology, Goldman Sachs expects the company to benefit from strong demand in data centers, aerospace and defense, with revenue projected about 1% above market forecasts and gross margins expected to rebound to roughly 66% by the end of 2026.

The analyst also believes Wall Street is underestimating the recovery of Microchip’s analog chip business and lists the company as one of its "top picks." Goldman Sachs’ profit estimate for its 2027 fiscal year is about 3% higher than market consensus. Microchip’s stock is up 27.62% year‑to‑date.
According to TipRanks’ stock comparison tool, based on analysts’ target prices, Microchip has the highest potential upside at 30.49%, followed by Seagate at 27.96%, and Applied Materials at 25.00%.
Wall Street consensus ratings are "Strong Buy" for Applied Materials and Seagate, and "Moderate Buy" for Microchip Technology.

items.title: 特斯拉Cybercab要來歐洲了！巴黎車展首度亮相但不開放搭乘
items.title_en: Tesla's Cybercab Heads to Europe! Debuts at Paris Motor Show but No Rides Offered
paras: 特斯拉(TSLA-US)將在10月12日揭幕的巴黎車展，首度於歐洲展示自駕計程車Cybercab。這款沒有方向盤與踏板的車型，是執行長馬斯克推動特斯拉轉型為AI產品公司的重要布局，不過本次展出不開放觀眾搭乘。
《彭博》報導，巴黎車展總監Serge Gachot周二(6日)接受電話訪問時表示，觀眾可試駕另外六輛搭載特斯拉「全自動輔助駕駛」(Full Self-Driving，FSD)系統的車輛。FSD是特斯拉用於其駕駛輔助系統的名稱，與此次僅供展示的Cybercab不同。
Cybercab被視為特斯拉跨足電動車以外領域、朝包括人形機器人在內的AI產品發展的關鍵。馬斯克將這款車定位為未來大型自駕計程車業務的核心，目標是服務美國大部分地區，並承諾最終部署數千輛車。
本屆巴黎車展也將成為歐洲車廠展現新產品與轉型策略的舞台。擁有寶獅(Peugeot)及雪鐵龍(Citroën)品牌的Stellantis(STLA-US)，計畫展出旗下八個品牌、逾60輛車，呈現執行長Antonio Filosa帶領下的重振布局。
雷諾預計展出約50輛汽車與概念車，包括大幅改款的電動車Dacia Spring。該車將在歐洲組裝，以符合鼓勵在地生產的獎勵措施資格。
其他參展車廠包括中國比亞迪(01211-HK)、小鵬汽車(XPEV-US)(09868-HK)，以及德國福斯。
BMW則已於今年稍早宣布退出本屆巴黎車展。在公司發布重大獲利預警後，新任執行長Milan Nedeljkovic正推動削減成本。
paras_en: Tesla (TSLA-US) will unveil its driverless Cybercab at the Paris Motor Show on October 12, marking the first time the steering‑wheel‑less, pedal‑free vehicle is shown in Europe. The model is a key part of CEO Elon Musk’s push to transform Tesla into an AI product company, but it will not be available for public rides at the show.

Bloomberg reported that Paris Motor Show director Serge Gachot said in a phone interview on Tuesday (the 6th) that visitors can test‑drive six other vehicles equipped with Tesla’s Full Self‑Driving (FSD) system. FSD is the name of Tesla’s driver‑assistance suite and is different from the Cybercab, which is being displayed only.

The Cybercab is seen as a crucial step for Tesla to move beyond electric cars into AI products, including humanoid robots. Musk positions the vehicle as the core of a future large‑scale autonomous taxi service, aiming to serve most of the United States and eventually deploy thousands of units.

This year’s Paris Motor Show will also serve as a stage for European automakers to showcase new products and transformation strategies. Stellantis (STLA-US), owner of Peugeot and Citroën, plans to exhibit over 60 models across its eight brands, reflecting CEO Antonio Filosa’s revitalisation plan.

Renault expects to display about 50 cars and concept vehicles, including a heavily refreshed electric Dacia Spring. The model will be assembled in Europe to qualify for incentives that reward local production.
Other exhibitors include China’s BYD (01211-HK), Xpeng (XPEV-US) (09868-HK), and Germany’s Volkswagen.

BMW announced earlier this year that it would withdraw from this edition of the Paris Motor Show. After the company issued a major profit warning, new CEO Milan Nedeljkovic is driving cost‑cutting measures.

items.title: AI搶電大戰升溫！Google簽20年核電大單 電力股盤中大漲
items.title_en: AI Power Battle Heats Up! Google Signs 20-Year Nuclear Power Deal, Utility Stocks Surge Midday
paras: Google與美國最大核電反應爐持有業者Constellation Energy(CEG-US)達成20年核電購電協議，透過升級11座既有反應爐，新增890MW發電容量，規模約等同一座大型反應爐。這是核電業者與科技公司歷來最大的既有機組增容合作，帶動電力股周二(6日)盤中大漲。
《華爾街日報》(WJS)報導，Constellation將投入逾43億美元，升級伊利諾州、賓州與紐澤西州的核電機組。公司股價午盤上漲約14%，Talen Energy(TLN-US)、Vistra(VST-US)及NRG Energy(NRG-US)也分別上漲13%、11%與8%。

升級既有反應爐 加速供應資料中心用電

Constellation執行長Joe Dominguez表示，公司多年來就知道能提高這些反應爐的輸出，但工程成本高昂，如今Google提供財務支持，才得以推動相當於新增一座反應爐的計畫。首項增容工程預計2028年交付，其餘工程將持續至2032年或2033年。
雙方另簽訂15年供電協議，在涵蓋美國中大西洋與中西部地區的PJM電力市場，供應額外2,700MW電力，並計畫合作開發新電源、電池儲能及需求反應方案，在電網吃緊時調整或降低用電。
大型資料中心的耗電量可比擬一座城市，促使科技巨頭積極鎖定長期電源。核電能全天候提供低碳電力，卻有建造昂貴、耗時的難題。Google能源主管Amanda Peterson Corio表示，在資料中心備受批評之際，以負責任的方式迅速取得穩定、乾淨電力，格外重要。

科技巨頭搶核電 增容與重啟成優先選項

Google母公司Alphabet(GOOGL-US)近來積極增加電網供給。Google上月宣布支持喬治亞州核電廠升級，也與NextEra Energy(NEE-US)合作重啟愛荷華州Duane Arnold核電廠，並向反應爐開發商Kairos Power的計畫購電。
美國新建核電廠過去常面臨工期漫長與預算超支，既有機組升級及重啟近期關閉的反應爐，因此被視為較快增加供給的途徑，也符合川普政府擴大核電的方向。
Meta(META-US)今年與Vistra簽訂20年協議，包含俄亥俄州與賓州三座電廠合計433MW增容；亞馬遜(AMZN-US)上周也與Constellation簽署20年購電協議，涵蓋一座核電廠190MW增容計畫。
微軟(MSFT-US)則透過與Constellation合作，支持重啟賓州三哩島未受事故損壞的反應爐。該機組2019年因營運成本過高關閉，如今更名為Crane清潔能源中心，反映AI用電熱潮正改變核電投資條件。
paras_en: Google has reached a 20-year nuclear power purchase agreement with Constellation Energy (CEG-US), the largest U.S. nuclear reactor owner, to upgrade 11 existing reactors and add 890 MW of generation capacity—roughly the output of a large new reactor. This is the biggest capacity‑expansion partnership between a nuclear operator and a tech company ever, spurring utility stocks to jump sharply on Tuesday (the 6th).

The Wall Street Journal reports that Constellation will invest more than $4.3 billion to upgrade reactors in Illinois, Pennsylvania and New Jersey. The company’s shares rose about 14% by midday, while Talen Energy (TLN-US), Vistra (VST-US) and NRG Energy (NRG-US) gained 13%, 11% and 8% respectively.

Upgrading Existing Reactors to Accelerate Power Supply for Data Centers
Constellation CEO Joe Dominguez said the firm has long known it could boost output from these reactors, but the engineering costs are high. Google’s financial backing now makes it possible to pursue a project equivalent to building a new reactor. The first capacity‑increase project is slated for delivery in 2028, with the remaining upgrades continuing through 2032 or 2033.

The parties also signed a 15‑year power‑supply agreement covering the PJM market in the Mid‑Atlantic and Midwest, delivering an additional 2,700 MW of electricity and planning joint development of new generation, battery storage and demand‑response solutions to curtail or shift usage when the grid is tight.

Large data centers consume power comparable to a city, prompting tech giants to lock in long‑term energy sources. Nuclear power can provide round‑the‑clock low‑carbon electricity, but it is costly and time‑consuming to build. Google energy head Amanda Peterson Corio said that, amid criticism of data‑center energy use, securing stable, clean power responsibly is especially important.

Tech giants are scrambling for nuclear power, making capacity upgrades and reactor restarts top priorities. Alphabet (GOOGL-US) has recently been boosting grid supply: last month Google announced support for upgrades at a Georgia nuclear plant, partnered with NextEra Energy (NEE-US) to restart Iowa’s Duane Arnold reactor, and bought power from Kairos Power’s reactor development project.

New nuclear builds in the U.S. have historically suffered long schedules and budget overruns, so upgrading existing units and restarting recently shut reactors are seen as faster ways to add supply and align with the Trump administration’s push to expand nuclear power.

Meta (META-US) this year signed a 20‑year deal with Vistra that includes a 433 MW capacity increase across three plants in Ohio and Pennsylvania; Amazon (AMZN-US) last week also signed a 20‑year power‑purchase agreement with Constellation covering a 190 MW upgrade at a nuclear plant.

Microsoft (MSFT-US) is supporting the restart of a non‑damaged reactor at Pennsylvania’s Three Mile Island through its partnership with Constellation. The unit was shut in 2019 due to high operating costs, and has been renamed the Crane Clean Energy Center, reflecting how the AI‑driven power surge is reshaping nuclear investment conditions.
